feed.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion

entry.title: Decentralized Coinbase Payout Protocols (DCPP): A Framework for Discussion
entry.summary:
A fixed upper limit of 16 payout slots is proposed as a protocol-wide constant, offering a reasonable safety margin. This approach discourages reliance on firmware claims regarding slot capacity, instead ensuring predictability and standardization across implementations. By setting this minimum at the protocol level, every valid transaction template would include exactly 16 payout slots whenever at least that many participants are eligible.
Such determinism eliminates the need for miners to assess or model their likelihood of inclusion based on fluctuating hardware distributions within mining pools. This is particularly beneficial for those whose hashrate hovers near the threshold for participation, as it provides clarity about slot allocation. Additionally, establishing a consistent slot count could simplify the design of value-weighted draw schemes, enhancing both fairness and technical efficiency.
There is an anticipation that, in the future, the growth of decentralized mining pools may grant them sufficient influence to encourage hardware manufacturers to expand or remove current firmware-imposed limits. Until then, maintaining a standardized, deterministic slot allocation mechanism offers stability and operational simplicity for all network participants.
